measured_cost_evidence.finding: THE NON-ROOT DEPTH OPERATOR IS 1.39x ITS PRICED CELL.

depth_causal_kl_greedy_v1._why: the priced cell was rebuilt from ONE real production Top-K invocation AT THE ROOT. Non-root states have different geometry, and the candidate workload is unchanged -- 260 candidate subsets, 5980 ablated forwards, 17420 ablated items per invocation, identical to the root measurement. So this is a per-state cost difference, not a workload difference.

other_operators.note: attention, ffn and width together are 1/42 of a DEPTH invocation. DEPTH is 90% of the search's operator time.

where_this_applies: D2/D3 full-search pricing, which execute the same non-root DEPTH path
any future search executing depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1 off the root
measured_cost_evidence._why_not: neither rung executes the DEPTH operator. Inflating a behavioural price because a search operator was slower would be attributing a cost to work that does not do it.
